items.title: Hotel Chocolat issues recall following suspected contamination
items.summary: Mars-owned Hotel Chocolat recalls pistachio chocolates over salmonella fears after identifying a potential contamination risk linked to a pistachio paste ingredient. The precautionary recall affects a limited number of products sold in early October, with customers urged not to…

items.title: Prosecco's 'Heroic' Vines Offer A Test Case In Climate Resilience
items.summary: Italy's Conegliano Valdobbiadene region, home to some of the most exclusive Prosecco wines, is emerging as a test case for climate adaptation.

items.title: Meituan Q3 Revenue Meets Estimates As Delivery Demand Offsets Competition
items.summary: Food delivery company Meituan has ​reported revenue and profit that were in line with or slightly outpaced market estimates.

items.title: GLP-1s could reshape the global food system
items.summary: GLP-1 use could cut global deaths, reduce food demand and return millions of hectares of agricultural land to nature by 2050

items.title: South African Retailer SPAR Flags Up To 50% Drop In Annual Earnings
items.summary: SPAR Group expects annual headline earnings to fall by up to 49.5%, citing operational issues and rising credit losses tied to franchisees.
